locator.excerpt:
{
  "path": "/v1/contracts/{source}/{id}",
  "method": "GET",
  "summary": "Detalii contract",
  "description": "Obține detaliile unui contract după sursa de date și ID-ul numeric",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "source",
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "achizitii-directe",
          "licitatii-publice",
          "achizitii-offline"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "id",
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "description": "ID-ul contractului: noticeId (numeric, ex: 123456) sau noticeNo (string, ex: DA123456)",
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "security": null,
  "securitySchemes": {
    "bearerAuth": {
      "type": "http",
      "scheme": "bearer",
      "description": "Autentificare prin cheie API"
    }
  },
  "response_properties": [
    "source",
    "noticeId",
    "publicationDate",
    "noticeNo",
    "acquisitionState",
    "name",
    "cpvCode",
    "supplier",
    "awardedValue",
    "contractDescription",
    "contractType",
    "europeanFund",
    "contractItems",
    "hasMoreItems",
    "totalItems",
    "contractingAuthority",
    "contractingAuthorityFiscalNumber",
    "cityAuthority",
    "countyAuthority",
    "supplierFiscalNumber",
    "supplierCity",
    "supplierCounty"
  ]
}
